label: A prediction with an uncertainty
subgoals: Read the surrogate output as a mean and a predictive sigma
Compute Phi of minus mean over sigma for the violation probability
Decide by the probability rather than by the point prediction

label: A recursion rule
subgoals: Compare the absolute predicted margin with k predictive sigmas
Send candidates inside the band to the accurate engine
Sum the violation probabilities of accepted passes for the expected false passes

label: Calibration is the precondition
subgoals: Standardize held-out errors by the predicted sigma
Check that the coverage of the two-sigma band is near 95 percent
Force recursion for inputs outside the training distribution
